result.title: Where Do the Gaussians Go? Foreground Attraction for Camera-Based Weakly Supervised 3D Occupancy
result.summary: Camera-based 3D semantic occupancy models can be trained without 3D labels by rendering their predictions into the images and supervising them with 2D pseudo labels. In sparse Gaussian representations trained this way, Gaussian positions are learned only through pixel-wise rendering losses, which we hypothesize give small foreground objects little weight. In trained GaussianFlowOcc models, the Gaussian density on foreground voxels is on average only 1.62 times that on background voxels. We propose a training-only foreground attraction loss that back-projects foreground pseudo-label pixels with pseudo depth and pulls nearby Gaussians toward these 3D points, favoring Gaussians that already predict the target class; the inference network is unchanged. On Occ3D-nuScenes, the loss raises this concentration to 2.40 over three seeds. Over three seeds, the mean foreground IoU increases from 6.29 to 6.96 and is higher for each seed, whereas the change in mean mIoU (13.53 to 13.82) is within the seed-to-seed variation of the baseline. Single-run ablations further indicate that pseudo-label targets outperform targets placed at ground-truth voxels and that acting on the Gaussian positions alone is not sufficient, and a single-seed test shows that the model degrades less when fewer Gaussians are kept at inference.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究相机弱监督3D语义占据中的稀疏高斯表示，发现像素级渲染损失使前景小目标获得的高斯密度偏低，为此提出仅训练期使用的前景吸引损失：将前景伪标签像素按伪深度反投影，把附近高斯拉向这些3D点并偏向已预测目标类别者，推理网络不变，从而提升前景高斯密度与前景IoU。
AI.relevance_reason: 训练期监督把有限表示容量集中到任务关键视觉区域的思路，可能对 LVR 中「潜在状态是否保留任务必要视觉细节」以及监督信号如何塑形内部状态提供可核查线索；但其对象为3D占据的几何原语，与 VLM 推理期 latent 生成距离较远，需较多核查。
